title: Siege of Belgrade (1690)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Belgrade (1690)", at revision 1370739435, opens: "The siege of Belgrade in 1690 was the fifth siege of that city, taking place during the Great Turkish War." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q7509869, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1690 siege of the Great Turkish War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
